description: Members of the buddy network the person could book a 60-minute mock interview with now, soonest available first: each host's handle, a coarse card (category, seniority, country), the topics they offer, their next open slot and their review rating. Never includes a meeting link.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the times are shown in, e.g. Europe/Berlin. An unknown or missing zone falls back to UTC; the result names the zone it used.
